offers_products.reason: Distributes test and measurement equipment from 500+ manufacturers, new, used and rental; distribution is a main segment.

offers_services.reason: Accredited calibration, repair, on-site service and compliance services are the larger part of the business.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are pharma, medical device, aerospace, energy and manufacturing firms, plus hospitals and government.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells calibration and equipment to pharmaceutical, medical device, aerospace, utility and government customers.

recurring_revenue.reason: Periodic recurring calibration of customers' instruments, required by regulation, brings repeat business from the same customers.

cyclical_demand.reason: Calibration is compliance-driven maintenance in regulated industries, so customers can't easily postpone it; equipment sales are somewhat more cyclical.

big_ticket.reason: Calibration jobs are routine, frequent and low-value per instrument; distributed test equipment is modest in price.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from accredited labs, calibration equipment and technicians' work, plus product distribution; it is lab-based, not purely staff time.

large_customers.reason: 19 of top 20 pharma companies, 8 of top 10 medical device makers, plus aerospace and utilities.

asset_heavy.reason: Runs 25+ calibration labs and a rental fleet, but growth is mainly through acquisitions and moderate lab investment.

notes: Service (calibration) is the larger segment; distribution of test equipment is the other part. Labs and rental fleet make the asset-heavy answer borderline.
